One island. One 8-mode decomposition. Every hex placed in latent space without a single human label — then projected back onto the map.

Emergent modes

M0 JURONG INDUSTRIAL ESTATE 6% Pure business land — petrochemical and heavy industry. No demand, no anchors, no residents.
M1 OUTER HDB ESTATES 18% Population-dense residential rings with low amenity diversity — the heartland edge.
M2 MIXED-USE ACTIVITY HUBS 18% Town cores stacked with beauty, retail and medical anchors — close to an MRT line.
M3 OFF-GRID OUTLIERS 5% Four-plus hex rings to the nearest MRT — outlying islands and the Tuas extension.
M4 CIVIC & RESORT FRINGE 16% Cafés, clinics, bars per resident skew high — Sentosa, the port, fringe estates.
M5 TUAS INDUSTRIAL FRONTIER 7% Active industrial coastline — heavy footprint, bus-served, no homes.
M6 COASTAL RESERVES 8% Special-use coastline — airports, ports, islands with their own brand-mix signature.
M7 MID-DENSITY MIXED 21% Walkable suburban hexes with a mid-tier shop layer — the residential connective tissue.
